title: SNMP default community string on a critical storage device

case_origin.source: Tenable vulnerability export supplied for thesis experiment

experimental_selection_reason: Low scanner severity on a source asset marked Critical; selected to test whether the assessment distinguishes technical severity from asset criticality.

finding.synopsis: The community name of the remote SNMP server can be guessed.
finding.description:
It is possible to obtain the default community name of the remote SNMP server.

An attacker may use this information to gain more knowledge about the remote host, or to change the configuration of the remote system (if the default community allows such modifications).
finding.recommended_remediation:
Disable the SNMP service on the remote host if you do not use it.
Either filter incoming UDP packets going to this port, or change the default community string.
